profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer at Basic Fun
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Developer and Technology Manager with a demonstrated history of applications development across multiple industries. Information technology professional skilled in VB, C#, SQL, PHP, API’s, IT Strategy, Management, and Software Documentation.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Senior designer and developer of a.NET and SQL Server web based application for the construction industry. The core feature of the application is the incorporation of the county property appraiser data that is used to validate the property and owner information. This allows for seamless processing of contracts, permitting, and project management from the office and the jobsite.

positions.title: Information Technology Manager
positions.description:
• Implemented Operating System and Software standardization.
• Implemented Computerized Scheduling, Dispatching, Job Tracking, Payroll, and Billing System
• Upgraded and enhanced the company network – capabilities were improved through the installation of Microsoft Windows 2003 Server and Microsoft Exchange 2003 Server.
• Extended system inter-connectivity through the addition of wireless networking devices.
• Established company computer usage standards.
• Developed and deployed company Web site.

positions.title: Information Technology Manager
positions.description:
• Assembled and managed the in-house programming group.
• Led the development of a WEB based Microsoft .NET application for Event and Crowd Management – this application utilized “Code Behind” techniques, Microsoft SQL, and the Microsoft Visual Studio .NET tools and environment.
• Developed and defined the .NET application SQL database structures and tables.
• Instituted Microsoft “Best Practices” for software and application development.
• Upgraded and enhanced the corporate network and data communications – capabilities were improved and expanded through the installation of Microsoft Windows 2000 Enterprise based servers, Gigabit networking, and T1 data lines.
• Established corporate computer usage standards.
• Established continuing education and certification standards for the programming group.

positions.title: Federal Sales Account Manager / Business Development Executive
positions.description:
• Develop and managed federal sales accounts – Aerospace Corp., Bechtel Nevada, Rockwell Science Center, Shafer Corp., Jet Propulsion Laboratory, SAIC, TRW, XonTech Inc.
• Customer consultations and presentations – based upon consultations with the customer I would design a networked or stand-alone configuration that would meet the needs of the project while allowing for the system to grow as the customers needs evolved using COTS products.
• Provided pre- and post-sales customer support – consult with the customer on the merits of different technologies (UNIX vs. Windows, Networked vs. Stand-Alone, Workstations vs. Terminals, Client/Server vs. Peer-to-Peer) when used to support the customers’ needs.
• Managed Technical Sales Support specialists – directed both support specialists in product specifications and product sales quote preparation.
• Teamed with Silicon Graphics Inc. Account Managers on account visits.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
• Top Secret US Government security clearance with special accesses.
• Research and development of new hardware and software products – activities included evaluation, testing and implementation of radar analog-to-digital data acquisition boards, radar imaging computer systems, data processing systems, data storage systems, secure communications equipment for voice and data transmission, and network systems implementation.
• Special projects programming technical manager – lead designer and programmer, using Microsoft Visual C++, to develop an application that would translate user inputs into a radar control script to be used to control radar functions for data collection. The initial layout was completed in three weeks and the first fully functioning version of the program was completed in six months. The program was designed in a modular mode to be adaptable to many different types of radar systems.
